What you get

The player takes the colour of the cover

Open Now Playing and the whole screen glows in the album's palette. Skip a track and the room changes with it.

Search by mood and language

Type "rain" or pick Tamil. Results group into tracks, artists and albums as you type, with the language shown next to each one.

One queue that stays put

Browse artists, albums and playlists while the music keeps playing. Add to the queue from any list and see what comes next in one tap.

Made to be read, too

Large type, plain labels and light and dark themes that hold the same contrast. Everything works on a phone with one thumb.
